claims.statement: The selected passage supplies the main textual evidence central to Translation Philosophy and Responsible Tools.

learning.foundation_objective: Analyse the relevant text and explain the case that translations make linguistic decisions; lexicons, interlinears, and commentaries require contextual use and awareness of limitations.
learning.extension_objective: Test the claim against context, genre, canonical synthesis, credible alternatives, and the limits of the available evidence.
